description: Assign a price list to a customer without a company (a B2C VIP); null unassigns. One list per buyer: a customer in a company pays the company's list, so assigning to them is refused - assign the list to the company with set_company_price_list instead. Returns the customer with priceList (their own) and effectivePriceList (the one that prices them, source MEMBER or COMPANY).

priceListId.description: The price list's id (from list_price_lists); null unassigns
